import hashlib,json,math,os,shlex
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
assert os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")==""
root=Path("test-results/pr33824_expanded_all13_predictors_20260928_1933").resolve()
base=root/"models/Qwen3-14B"
hashes={}
def read(path):
    data=path.read_bytes()
    hashes[str(path)]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    return data.decode()
def records(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in read(path).splitlines() if line.strip()]
def prompt_hash(row):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(row["input_ids"],separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()
audit=json.loads(read(root/"verification/qwen3_14b_completed_calibration_20260929_1124/results/manifest.json"))
assert (audit["model"],audit["training_requests"],audit["training_cases"],audit["timing_rows"])==("Qwen3-14B",800,15,9256)
train_ids=set(); train_prompts=set()
for number in range(1,6):
    group=base/f"calibration/real/repeat-{number}"
    assert read(group/"BASELINE_COLLECTION_COMPLETE").strip()=="complete"
    for case in ("latency_256x128_r1","service_1024x256_r4","saturation_1024x256_inf"):
        rows=records(group/"cases"/case/"TP0.raw_request.jsonl")
        assert len(rows)==(32 if case=="latency_256x128_r1" else 64)
        ids={r["rid"] for r in rows}
        assert len(ids)==len(rows) and not train_ids & ids
        train_ids.update(ids); train_prompts.update(prompt_hash(r) for r in rows)
assert len(train_ids)==800 and len(train_prompts)==480
test_ids=set(); test_prompts=set(); counts=[]
for number in (1,2,3,4):
    group=base/f"holdout/real/repeat-{number}"
    assert read(group/"BASELINE_COLLECTION_COMPLETE").strip()=="complete"
    assert read(group/"package_versions.txt")==read(base/"calibration/real/repeat-1/package_versions.txt")
    for case,n in (("latency_256x128_r1",32),("service_1024x256_r4",64),("saturation_1024x256_inf",64),("latency_128x64_r1",32),("saturation_1536x384_inf",64)):
        folder=group/"cases"/case
        assert read(folder/"status.txt").strip()=="ok"
        server=shlex.split(read(folder.parent/(case+".server.command.txt")))
        client=shlex.split(read(folder.parent/(case+".benchmark.command.txt")))
        def arg(argv,key):
            assert argv.count(key)==1,(case,key)
            return argv[argv.index(key)+1]
        assert arg(client,"--seed")==str(202609379+number) and int(arg(client,"--num-prompts"))==n
        assert arg(server,"--device")=="cuda" and arg(server,"--attention-backend")=="triton"
        assert arg(server,"--mem-fraction-static")=="0.60" and arg(server,"--context-length")=="2048"
        assert "--disable-cuda-graph" in server and "--disable-overlap-schedule" in server
        manifest=json.loads(read(folder/"TP0.manifest.json"))
        benchmark=records(folder/"benchmark.jsonl")[-1]
        raw=records(folder/"TP0.raw_request.jsonl")
        trace=records(folder/"autobench_trace.jsonl")
        assert len(raw)==len(trace)==manifest["request_count"]==benchmark["completed"]==n
        assert benchmark["server_info"]["device"]=="cuda" and benchmark["server_info"]["attention_backend"]=="triton"
        ids={r["rid"] for r in raw}; assert len(ids)==n and not test_ids & ids
        test_ids.update(ids); test_prompts.update(prompt_hash(r) for r in raw)
        copied={r["metadata"]["source_rid"]:r for r in trace}
        assert set(copied)==ids
        for row in raw:
            replay=copied[row["rid"]]
            assert row["input_ids"]==replay["prompt"] and len(row["input_ids"])==row["input_length"]==replay["prompt_len"]
            assert len(row["output_ids"])==row["output_length"]==replay["output_len"]
        batches=records(folder/"TP0.schedule_batch.jsonl")
        assert len(batches)==manifest["schedule_batch_count"]
        assert manifest["batch_timing"]=="device_synchronized" and manifest["batch_latency_unit"]=="seconds"
        phase={1:0,2:0}
        for row in batches:
            latency=float(row["iter_latency"])
            assert row["forward_mode"] in phase and row["request_infos"] and math.isfinite(latency) and latency>0
            assert math.isclose(row["end_timestamp"]-row["start_timestamp"],latency,rel_tol=1e-12,abs_tol=1e-12)
            assert {r["rid"] for r in row["request_infos"]}<=ids
            phase[row["forward_mode"]]+=1
        counts.append({"repeat":number,"case":case,"requests":n,"timing_rows":len(batches),"prefill_rows":phase[1],"decode_rows":phase[2]})
assert len(test_ids)==1024 and not train_ids & test_ids and not train_prompts & test_prompts
for path,digest in hashes.items(): assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
result={"at":datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),"model":"Qwen3-14B","closed_heldout_groups":4,"training_requests":len(train_ids),"unique_training_prompts":len(train_prompts),"test_requests":len(test_ids),"unique_test_prompts":len(test_prompts),"cross_role_request_id_overlap":len(train_ids & test_ids),"cross_role_complete_prompt_overlap":len(train_prompts & test_prompts),"test_timing_rows":sum(r["timing_rows"] for r in counts),"test_prefill_rows":sum(r["prefill_rows"] for r in counts),"test_decode_rows":sum(r["decode_rows"] for r in counts),"case_counts":counts,"heldout_package_versions_equal_training":True,"source_sha256_unchanged":hashes,"fit_prediction_or_gpu_work":False,"scope":"Completed first four heldout groups versus all completed training requests; identity and native observation integrity only, not accuracy or all-five heldout completion."}
print(json.dumps(result))
